# Factions
[color=yellow]Factions[/color] are the core mechanic of Nibiru. You can create them, be a member, or be hostile towards them.
# Creating and Managing a Faction
To create a faction, open the faction creation window — the button with a shield icon is located in the upper left corner of the screen. There you need to choose a name for your future faction and click the create button. If a faction with that name already exists, you will not be able to create it.
After creation, you can invite players to your faction by right-clicking on a player without a faction and selecting [color=yellow]"Invite to faction"[/color]. Then it all depends on whether the person you sent the invitation to accepts or not.
To open the faction for players to join from the lobby, you need to check the "open for joining" option. In that case, if a player from the lobby selects your faction, they will appear next to a random faction member and automatically become a member of the faction.
You can [color=red]expel[/color] faction members from anywhere, and they will lose all recipes learned by the faction. But you can only transfer the title and appoint a successor when you are in [color=yellow]direct line of sight[/color] with the person you want to pass leadership to.
When transferring leadership, you obviously cease to be the leader and leadership passes to the one you transferred it to. When appointing a successor, they will become leader only if the previous leader dies. If no successor was appointed, a random faction member becomes leader. For faction members, only the faction name and their leader's name are displayed.
